question: What biodiesel yield did Harb et al. obtain from spent coffee ground oil, and at what methanol-to-oil ratio and temperature?
expect: 90.31% yield, 12:1, 60 °C (p2); Table 11 lists Harb & Jaoudeh at 95% conversion
rendered:
Document 1

Harb et al. prepared a kinetic model in Aspen Plus to generate biodiesel from spent coffee ground oil and achieved a biodiesel yield of 90.31% with a methanol to oil ratio of 12 : 1 and reaction temperature of 60 °C.
